zh: 已经拥有的不同编号（包括超出1到n范围的）都直接计入答案，重复编号只算一次；需要最大化的只是新买商品的数量。
每件新商品贡献都是1，而价格等于编号，所以应当从最便宜的未拥有商品开始买；交换论证可以证明按价格递增购买是最优的。
先对已拥有的编号去重并计数；再从1到n依次检查：已拥有则跳过；否则若价格超过剩余预算就停止，不然扣除价格、答案加1。
en: Every distinct owned number counts directly, including those outside 1..n, and duplicates count once; only the number of newly bought items needs to be maximized.
Each new item contributes exactly 1 while its price equals its number, so buy the cheapest items you do not own first; an exchange argument shows that buying in increasing order of price is optimal.
Deduplicate and count the owned numbers first; then check 1 to n in order: skip owned items; otherwise stop if the price exceeds the remaining budget, else subtract the price and add 1 to the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Deduplicate the owned numbers, then go from 1 to n buying each item you do not own while you can afford it; stop when you cannot.

## Proof of correctness

All distinct owned numbers count for free, and each newly bought item contributes 1. If a plan buys a more expensive unowned item but skips a cheaper one, swapping them keeps the count and does not increase the cost; repeated swaps turn it into a prefix of items chosen in increasing order of price, so the greedy choice is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n+m), space O(m).
